suggestions.reason: This is the strongest assertion in the set and the only one that checks spec-level correctness (path + required params). Consider extending the same rigor to response-shape: an answer could give the right path but hallucinate the response fields and still pass today.

No assertion guards accuracy of auxiliary region URLs. The paired without_skill run passed all five assertions while stating the India base URL as https://api.in.cast.ai, which is not the documented form (docs.cast.ai/docs/api-access says https://api.india.cast.ai). If region-table accuracy matters for this support-persona skill, add an assertion like "If an India region URL is mentioned, it matches the official docs form (api.india.cast.ai)" — or require that any regional URL beyond US/EU be verified against an official source before inclusion.

eval_feedback.overall: Passing 5/5 is genuinely earned for this run: the answer is spec-accurate on the core ask (401 diagnosis, EU base URL, savings endpoint with correct required params, X-API-Key auth) and every graded fact was verified live against the OpenAPI spec and docs. The one factual soft spot is the unverifiable runValueRealizationTimelineReport aside, which the answer properly hedges as optional. The main eval gap is that nothing checks the accuracy of extra region URLs — a gap the without_skill sibling run exposed by stating a wrong India URL while still passing.
